title: Pre-Qualification Letter Age and the Activated Homesite Reservation Hold
content:
The age of the buyer's pre-qualification letter on the reservation date sets the activation letter shortening of a Homesite Reservation hold. The age is counted in calendar days from the date printed on the letter (as on the reservation record) to the reservation date.

## Letter-age bands

| Letter age on the reservation date | Activation letter shortening |
|---|---|
| more than 45 days | 3 days |
| more than 30 days but no more than 45 days | 1 day |
| 30 days or less | zero |

## Boundary days

| Letter age (days) | Band | Shortening |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 30 days or less | zero |
| 31 | more than 30 but no more than 45 | 1 day |
| 45 | more than 30 but no more than 45 | 1 day |
| 46 | more than 45 | 3 days |

## Date illustration (hypothetical)

A letter dated 1 February and a reservation dated 18 March: the age is 45 days (27 days to 28 February plus 18 days in March, in a year where February has 28 days), so the shortening is 1 day. Had the reservation been dated 19 March, the age would be 46 days and the shortening 3 days.
